title: With Moonshot's free Kimi K3, China changes the sovereign AI equation
summary_en: China's Moonshot AI has released its strongest chatbot, Kimi K3, for anyone to download and run for free. This matters most to governments that have spent heavily on their own AI hardware but still pay U.S. companies for the software. The article looks at who might actually switch, and why free has not been enough so far. It also asks what a country really owns when it downloads a model.
summary_zh: 中國 Moonshot AI 在 7 月 27 日免費釋出最強聊天機器人 Kimi K3 的模型權重，任何政府、公司或個人都能在自己的機器上執行並重新訓練。這對已經砸大錢買硬體、卻還要付錢租用美國 AI 軟體的國家衝擊最大。但免費不等於會被採用——過去一年多的免費中國模型，至今沒有任何國家拿來當國家級 AI 專案的基礎。更根本的限制是晶片：跑得動 Kimi K3 的先進晶片由美國決定賣給誰，下載了模型也只是拿到軟體而已。

scan_questions.question: Where does Kimi K3 rank on Artificial Analysis's index, and which systems are above it?
scan_questions.answer_zh: 第三名。排在它前面的是 Anthropic 的 Claude Fable 5 和 OpenAI 的 GPT-5.6 Sol Max，這兩個都要付費。

scan_questions.question: According to the Sovereign AI Index, which free model did governments actually pick most often?
scan_questions.answer_zh: Meta 的 Llama，十個裡面有四個選它。沒有任何一個國家選 DeepSeek 或 Moonshot 先前的聊天機器人，即使那些也免費、評價也高。

scan_questions.question: What does a country still not get, even after downloading Kimi K3 for free?
scan_questions.answer_zh: 晶片、資料中心，以及之後的下一代模型。跑得動這種規模模型的先進晶片由美國決定賣給誰，所以下載到的只有軟體本身。

paragraphs.text: The best artificial intelligence technology any country can own is now available for free.
paragraphs.translation: 任何國家能擁有的最強人工智慧技術，現在免費就能取得。

paragraphs.text: On July 27, China’s Moonshot AI put its most powerful chatbot on the internet for anyone to use. The Alibaba-backed developer released the software behind its AI model Kimi K3, allowing any government, company, or individual to run it on their own computers without paying Beijing-based Moonshot. Users can also retrain the chatbot to fit their own language and laws.
paragraphs.translation: 7 月 27 日，中國的 Moonshot AI 把自家最強大的聊天機器人放上網路供任何人使用。這家由阿里巴巴支持的開發商釋出了旗下 AI 模型 Kimi K3 背後的軟體，讓任何政府、公司或個人都能在自己的電腦上執行，不必付錢給總部設在北京的 Moonshot。使用者也可以重新訓練這個聊天機器人，讓它符合自己的語言與法規。

paragraphs.text: Nations are spending billions of dollars to run sovereign systems or AI on their own soil so that citizen data stays within their borders and can’t be accessed by foreign companies or governments. Most countries own the machines but lease the computing power and software from U.S. companies such as Microsoft, Google, and Amazon, which count on the rent continuing for years. Kimi K3 offers those governments a way out.
paragraphs.translation: 各國正花費數十億美元建立主權系統，也就是在自己國土上運作的 AI，好讓國民資料留在國界內、不被外國公司或政府取用。多數國家擁有機器，但向微軟、Google、亞馬遜這些美國公司租用運算資源與軟體，而這些公司預期租金會持續收上好幾年。Kimi K3 給了這些政府一條出路。

paragraphs.text: “An open, high-quality model like Kimi K3 does change the calculation for governments that have been investing heavily in hardware while paying for access to American models,” Mohammed Soliman, a senior fellow at Washington-based think tank Middle East Institute, told Rest of World. “If a competitive model becomes freely available, the return on those hardware investments increases because governments can reduce or eliminate ongoing licensing costs.”
paragraphs.translation: 「像 Kimi K3 這樣開放又高品質的模型，確實改變了那些政府的算盤——他們一直大手筆投資硬體，同時還要付錢取用美國的模型，」華盛頓智庫中東研究所的資深研究員 Mohammed Soliman 告訴《Rest of World》。「如果一個有競爭力的模型變成免費可得，那些硬體投資的報酬率就會提高，因為政府可以減少甚至完全不用再付持續性的授權費。」

paragraphs.text: Kimi K3 ranks third on Artificial Analysis’s index of the best AI systems, behind Anthropic’s Claude Fable 5 and OpenAI’s GPT-5.6 Sol Max, both of which charge users. Every free model in the world, including China’s DeepSeek and Meta’s Llama, sits below Kimi K3.
paragraphs.translation: 在 Artificial Analysis 的最佳 AI 系統排行榜上，Kimi K3 排名第三，僅次於 Anthropic 的 Claude Fable 5 和 OpenAI 的 GPT-5.6 Sol Max，而這兩個都要向使用者收費。世界上所有免費模型，包括中國的 DeepSeek 和 Meta 的 Llama，都排在 Kimi K3 之下。

paragraphs.text: Kimi K3 reads images as well as text, so it can work through scanned records, forms and photographs, and it can be reshaped to answer in Hindi, Arabic or Swahili, among other languages, as easily as in Chinese or English.
paragraphs.translation: Kimi K3 除了文字之外也讀得懂圖像，所以能處理掃描檔、表單和照片，而且可以被調整成用印地語、阿拉伯語或斯瓦希里語等語言回答，跟用中文或英文一樣順。

paragraphs.text: The chatbot has closed China’s gap with the best U.S. AI systems from months to weeks, according to a July report by researcher Ryan Fedasiuk of the American Enterprise Institute, a public-policy think tank.
paragraphs.translation: 根據公共政策智庫美國企業研究所的研究員 Ryan Fedasiuk 在七月發表的報告，這個聊天機器人已經把中國與最強美國 AI 系統之間的差距，從數個月縮短到數週。

paragraphs.text: “Chinese open-weight models are growing in popularity around the world as free and customizable alternatives to the closed U.S. frontier,” Vivek Chilukuri, program director for technology and national security at the Center for a New American Security, told Rest of World. “That’s true not only in more cost-sensitive emerging markets but in developer communities from Bangalore to San Francisco.”
paragraphs.translation: 「中國的開放權重模型正在全球越來越受歡迎，成為封閉的美國前沿模型之外免費又可客製化的替代選項，」新美國安全中心科技與國家安全計畫主任 Vivek Chilukuri 告訴《Rest of World》。「這不只發生在對成本比較敏感的新興市場，從班加羅爾到舊金山的開發者社群也是如此。」

paragraphs.text: Who benefits from Kimi K3?
paragraphs.translation: 誰會從 Kimi K3 受益？

paragraphs.text: The savings from free models like Kimi K3 can be largest in the countries that have already bought the hardware. Microsoft, Google, and Amazon have committed to building data centers and cloud services worth more than $30 billion across the Gulf, and more than $45 billion in India, among other regions.
paragraphs.translation: 像 Kimi K3 這種免費模型帶來的省錢效果，在已經買好硬體的國家身上可能最大。微軟、Google 和亞馬遜已承諾在波灣地區興建價值超過 300 億美元的資料中心與雲端服務，在印度則超過 450 億美元，其他地區還有更多。

paragraphs.text: India signed a deal with United Arab Emirates-backed G42 to deploy an AI supercomputer made of 64 U.S.-made systems on Indian soil, while continuing to pay U.S. companies for AI software. For India and every government in the same position, a model of Kimi K3’s rank is an option to run on machines inside their own borders.
paragraphs.translation: 印度與阿聯支持的 G42 簽約，要在印度國土上部署一台由 64 套美製系統組成的 AI 超級電腦，同時還持續付錢給美國公司買 AI 軟體。對印度以及每一個處境相同的政府來說，一個排名達到 Kimi K3 這種水準的模型，是個可以放在自家國界內機器上跑的選項。

paragraphs.text: Still, being free is no guarantee that governments will adopt it.
paragraphs.translation: 不過，免費並不保證政府就會採用。

paragraphs.text: Free Chinese models have been available for more than a year, yet no government has built its national AI project on one, as countries also judge the manuals, the legal terms, how well the software handles their languages, and where it comes from.
paragraphs.translation: 免費的中國模型已經存在一年多，但至今沒有任何政府把國家級 AI 專案建立在其中一個之上——因為各國同時也會評估技術文件、法律條款、軟體對自己語言的支援程度，以及它的來歷。

paragraphs.text: The Sovereign AI Index, which follows 139 state-backed AI projects across 56 countries and regions, found that where governments disclose the software underneath their AI, four in 10 chose Meta’s free U.S. model Llama, and not one chose DeepSeek or Moonshot’s earlier chatbots, even though those were free and highly rated.
paragraphs.translation: 追蹤 56 個國家與地區、139 個政府支持的 AI 專案的「主權 AI 指數」發現：在有揭露底層軟體的政府當中，十個裡有四個選了 Meta 的美國免費模型 Llama，而沒有任何一個選 DeepSeek 或 Moonshot 先前的聊天機器人，即使那些同樣免費、評價也很高。

paragraphs.text: Whether Kimi K3 breaks that pattern will likely depend partly on the support Moonshot provides and partly on government wariness about adopting Chinese models due to concerns of trust and surveillance, Pablo Chavez, an adjunct senior fellow at CNAS, which publishes the index, told Rest of World.
paragraphs.translation: Kimi K3 會不會打破這個模式，可能一部分取決於 Moonshot 提供的支援，一部分取決於各國政府對採用中國模型的戒心——那來自對信任與監控的疑慮，發布該指數的新美國安全中心兼任資深研究員 Pablo Chavez 告訴《Rest of World》。

paragraphs.text: “That tells me benchmark position alone doesn’t change what sovereign builders do,” Chavez said. “Instead, governments appear to choose base models the way they choose other infrastructure — documentation, licensing, language coverage, capability, and so forth.”
paragraphs.translation: 「這告訴我，光是排行榜上的位置並不會改變主權建置者的選擇，」Chavez 說。「相反地，政府挑選基礎模型的方式，看起來跟他們挑選其他基礎設施一樣——技術文件、授權條款、語言涵蓋範圍、能力等等。」

paragraphs.text: Countries should encourage open source, Chinese President Xi Jinping told the World AI Conference in Shanghai on July 17, pledging AI cooperation centers with the Arab League, the African Union and ASEAN. Alibaba has since announced Qwen 3.8 with a promise to give it away, while Nvidia, Google and OpenAI have all released free models this year.
paragraphs.translation: 中國國家主席習近平在 7 月 17 日上海的世界人工智慧大會上表示，各國應該鼓勵開源，並承諾與阿拉伯聯盟、非洲聯盟和東協設立 AI 合作中心。阿里巴巴隨後宣布推出 Qwen 3.8 並承諾免費釋出，而 Nvidia、Google 和 OpenAI 今年也都發布過免費模型。

paragraphs.text: While software like Kimi K3 may cost nothing, the machines that run it come at a price. A chatbot of Kimi K3’s size runs only on the most advanced chips, and the U.S. decides which countries can buy those chips. The Commerce Department went further last year and considered cutting off Chinese AI labs from U.S. technology altogether.
paragraphs.translation: 雖然像 Kimi K3 這樣的軟體可能不用錢，但跑得動它的機器是要付出代價的。Kimi K3 這種規模的聊天機器人只能在最先進的晶片上運作，而哪些國家買得到那些晶片是由美國決定。美國商務部去年更進一步，考慮過完全切斷中國 AI 實驗室取得美國技術的管道。

paragraphs.text: “U.S. export controls continue to confer enormous leverage on Washington, because the world desperately wants cutting-edge AI chips, which you need regardless of whether you’re running a U.S. or Chinese model,” Chilukuri said.
paragraphs.translation: 「美國的出口管制持續賦予華盛頓龐大的籌碼，因為全世界都極度渴望最尖端的 AI 晶片——不管你跑的是美國模型還是中國模型，你都需要它，」Chilukuri 說。

paragraphs.text: China has yet to fill that gap, as its chipmakers are unable to produce their most advanced processors in quantities large enough to export, Chilukuri said. A country that downloads Kimi K3 gets the software and nothing else, while the chips it runs on, the data centers that house it, and whatever model comes after it remain in other hands, Chavez said.
paragraphs.translation: Chilukuri 說，中國到目前為止還填補不了那個缺口，因為中國晶片製造商沒辦法把最先進的處理器生產到足以外銷的數量。Chavez 說，一個國家下載 Kimi K3 拿到的就只有軟體，而跑它的晶片、放它的資料中心，以及之後推出的下一代模型，都還握在別人手上。

paragraphs.text: “A government can hold a model’s weights and still depend on others for chips, data centers, and future models,” Chavez said. “Open weights address the risk of losing access, but they don’t remove the dependencies upstream.”
paragraphs.translation: 「一個政府可以握有一個模型的權重，卻仍然在晶片、資料中心和未來的模型上依賴別人，」Chavez 說。「開放權重解決了失去取用資格的風險，但它並沒有消除上游的那些依賴。」
